workflows.intelligence-safety.yml:
name: Ontology intelligence safety

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - "feat/mcp-jev-graph-readonly-*"
      - "feat/code-intelligence-*"
      - "feat/ragflow-retrieval-benchmark-*"
      - "feat/lightrag-comparison-*"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  intelligence-safety:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install test runtime
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install -e ".[dev,cad,bim,shacl,semantic,parquet,operational]" pillow

      - name: Compile Python sources
        run: python -m compileall -q src extensions

      - name: Test core package
        run: python -m pytest -q tests

      - name: Test MCP intelligence bridge
        run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_intelligence_bridge.py

      - name: Test intelligence extension
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: extensions/intelligence_fabric
        run: python -m pytest -q extensions/intelligence_fabric/tests/test_intelligence_fabric.py

      - name: Test drawing-context safety contracts
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: extensions/drawing_context
        run: python -m pytest -q extensions/drawing_context/tests

  operational-postgres:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build and start PostgreSQL (AGE + pgvector + PostGIS)
        run: |
          docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.db -t aec-postgres-age:ci docker
          docker run -d --name aec-db -e POSTGRES_DB=aec -e POSTGRES_USER=aec \
            -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=ci -p 55432:5432 aec-postgres-age:ci
          for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec aec-db pg_isready -U aec -d aec && break; sleep 1; done

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install test runtime
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install -e ".[dev,operational]"

      - name: Test operational stack against PostgreSQL
        env:
          AEC_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://aec:ci@localhost:55432/aec
        run: python -m pytest -q -rs tests/test_operational_postgres.py tests/test_operational_core.py tests/test_operational_census.py tests/test_operational_catalog.py tests/test_operational_blocks.py

workflows.ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main, "claude/**"]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install "ruff>=0.6"
      - run: ruff check .
      - run: ruff format --check .

  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.12", "3.13"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip
      - run: pip install -e ".[dev]"
      - run: python -m pytest -v
      - run: python -m power_cad_mcp --backend dxf --check

  dotnet:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"
      - run: dotnet restore dotnet/PowerCad.sln
      - name: Build (server, core, tests and the AutoCAD 2027 plugin against AutoCAD.NET 26.0.0)
        run: dotnet build dotnet/PowerCad.sln -c Release --no-restore
      - run: dotnet test dotnet/PowerCad.Tests -c Release --no-build --logger "console;verbosity=normal"

  package-windows:
    needs: [dotnet]
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"
      - name: Build bundle and self-contained server
        shell: bash
        run: ./scripts/build_dotnet.sh
      - name: Smoke-test the published server
        shell: bash
        run: ./dist/server/win-x64/power-cad-server.exe --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PowerCad-win-x64
          path: |
            dist/PowerCad.bundle/
            dist/server/win-x64/power-cad-server.exe
            scripts/install_autocad_plugin.ps1
            scripts/register_codex.ps1
            docs/framework/FRAMEWORK_IMPLEMENTATION.md

  build:
    needs: [lint, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install build
      - run: python -m build
      - name: Smoke-test the built wheel in a clean venv
        run: |
          python -m venv /tmp/wheeltest
          /tmp/wheeltest/bin/pip install dist/*.whl
          /tmp/wheeltest/bin/power-cad-mcp --version
          /tmp/wheeltest/bin/power-cad-mcp --backend dxf --check
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
workflows.release.yml:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  windows-package:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"
      - name: Build, test and package
        shell: bash
        run: ./scripts/build_dotnet.sh
      - name: Assemble release zip
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $stage = "PowerCad-${{ github.ref_name }}-win-x64"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$stage/dist/server/win-x64", "$stage/scripts" | Out-Null
          Copy-Item dist/PowerCad.bundle "$stage/dist/PowerCad.bundle" -Recurse
          Copy-Item dist/server/win-x64/power-cad-server.exe "$stage/dist/server/win-x64/"
          Copy-Item scripts/install_autocad_plugin.ps1 "$stage/scripts/"
          Copy-Item README.md, LICENSE "$stage/"
          Copy-Item docs/framework "$stage/docs" -Recurse
          & "$stage/dist/server/win-x64/power-cad-server.exe" --version
          Compress-Archive -Path "$stage/*" -DestinationPath "$stage.zip"
      - name: Publish GitHub release
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release create "${{ github.ref_name }}" "PowerCad-${{ github.ref_name }}-win-x64.zip" \
            --repo "${{ github.repository }}" \
            --title "Power CAD ${{ github.ref_name }}" \
            --notes "AutoCAD 2027 plugin bundle + self-contained power-cad-server.exe (win-x64).

          Install: unzip, then run in PowerShell from the unzipped folder:
          powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\\install_autocad_plugin.ps1 -SkipBuild

          Then restart AutoCAD 2027 and run POWERCAD_STATUS. Try without AutoCAD: dist\\server\\win-x64\\power-cad-server.exe --simulate"

workflows.ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Python ${{ matrix.python-version }} / ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        python-version: ["3.11"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install project
        run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Compile Python sources
        run: python -m compileall -q src tests scripts

      - name: CLI import smoke test
        run: python -m src.main --help

      - name: Environment doctor smoke test
        run: python -m src.main doctor

      - name: Run tests
        run: python -m pytest -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1 --junitxml=test-results/junit.xml

      - name: Upload test report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pytest-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: test-results/junit.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
workflows.build-windows-release.yml:
name: Build Windows Release

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "config/**"
      - "installer/**"
      - "scripts/build_windows*"
      - "release/**"
      - "tests/test_release_version.py"
      - "pyproject.toml"
      - ".github/workflows/build-windows-release.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]
    paths:
      - "release/VERSION"
      - ".github/workflows/build-windows-release.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Release version without v prefix"
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: windows-release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Resolve version
        id: version
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $version = "${{ inputs.version }}".Trim()
          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($version)) {
            $baseVersion = (Get-Content "release/VERSION" -Raw).Trim()
            if ("${{ github.ref_type }}" -eq "tag") {
              $version = "${{ github.ref_name }}".TrimStart("v")
            } elseif ("${{ github.event_name }}" -eq "pull_request") {
              $version = "$baseVersion-pr.${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
            } else {
              $version = $baseVersion
            }
          }
          if ($version -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+([-.][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$') {
            throw "Invalid release version: $version"
          }
          "version=$version" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Encoding utf8 -Append

      - name: Install build dependencies
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel setuptools
          python -m pip install -e ".[dev,build]"

      - name: Install Inno Setup
        shell: pwsh
        run: choco install innosetup --no-progress -y

      - name: Run release test suite
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force build/test-results | Out-Null
          python -m pytest -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1 --junitxml=build/test-results/windows-release.xml

      - name: Build portable executable
        shell: pwsh
        run: python scripts/build_windows_exe.py

      - name: Compile installer
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $candidates = @(
            "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe",
            "$env:ProgramFiles\Inno Setup 6\ISCC.exe"
          )
          $iscc = $candidates | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path $_) } | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $iscc) { throw "Inno Setup 6 compiler not found." }
          & $iscc "/DMyAppVersion=${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" "installer\HS-CAD.iss"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Inno Setup failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

      - name: Generate installer checksum
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $installer = Get-ChildItem dist/HS-CAD-Setup-*.exe | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $installer) { throw "Installer output was not found." }
          $hash = (Get-FileHash $installer.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          "$hash  $($installer.Name)" | Out-File "$($installer.FullName).sha256" -Encoding ascii

      - name: Upload diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: HS-CAD-build-diagnostics-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          path: |
            build/test-results/**
            build/pyinstaller/**
            build/spec/**
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload Windows package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: HS-CAD-Windows-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          path: |
            dist/HS-CAD.exe
            dist/HS-CAD.exe.sha256
            dist/HS-CAD-Setup-*.exe
            dist/HS-CAD-Setup-*.exe.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Publish GitHub release
        if: github.ref_type == 'tag' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          $version = "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          $tag = if ("${{ github.ref_type }}" -eq "tag") { "${{ github.ref_name }}" } else { "v$version" }
          $installer = Get-ChildItem dist/HS-CAD-Setup-*.exe | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $installer) { throw "Installer output was not found for release publishing." }
          $assets = @(
            (Resolve-Path "dist/HS-CAD.exe").Path,
            (Resolve-Path "dist/HS-CAD.exe.sha256").Path,
            $installer.FullName,
            (Resolve-Path "$($installer.FullName).sha256").Path
          )
          gh release view $tag *> $null
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            gh release upload $tag @assets --clobber
          } else {
            gh release create $tag @assets `
              --target "${{ github.sha }}" `
              --title "HS-CAD $version" `
              --generate-notes
          }
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "GitHub release publication failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

workflows.hscad_private_remote_worker.yml:
name: HS-CAD Private Remote DXF Worker

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "src/remote_worker/**"
      - "src/cad/dxf_inspector.py"
      - "src/cad/ezdxf_modifier.py"
      - "src/cad/svg_preview.py"
      - "src/cad/png_exporter.py"
      - "tests/test_remote_worker_*.py"
      - ".github/workflows/hscad_private_remote_worker.yml"
      - "jobs/examples/**"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "src/remote_worker/**"
      - "src/cad/dxf_inspector.py"
      - "src/cad/ezdxf_modifier.py"
      - "src/cad/svg_preview.py"
      - "src/cad/png_exporter.py"
      - "tests/test_remote_worker_*.py"
      - ".github/workflows/hscad_private_remote_worker.yml"
      - "jobs/examples/**"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      job_json_path:
        description: "Path to job JSON"
        required: true
        default: "jobs/examples/add_panel_notes.json"
      drive_file_id:
        description: "Optional Google Drive source file id"
        required: false
        default: ""
      drive_file_name:
        description: "Optional Google Drive source file name"
        required: false
        default: "source.dxf"

jobs:
  remote-dxf-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install "pydantic>=2" ezdxf pillow google-api-python-client google-auth google-auth-httplib2 google-auth-oauthlib pytest

      - name: Compile remote worker
        run: python -m compileall -q src tests

      - name: Run remote worker tests
        run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_remote_worker_job_schema.py tests/test_remote_worker_safety_guard.py tests/test_remote_worker_runner.py

      - name: Patch Drive input into job when provided
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.drive_file_id != '' }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path("${{ inputs.job_json_path }}")
          data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          data["source"] = {
              "type": "google_drive",
              "file_id": "${{ inputs.drive_file_id }}",
              "file_name": "${{ inputs.drive_file_name }}",
              "allow_blank": False,
          }
          patched = Path("outputs/runtime_job.json")
          patched.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          patched.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
          PY

      - name: Run worker with Drive input
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.drive_file_id != '' }}
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          GDRIVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ID: ${{ secrets.GDRIVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ID }}
        run: python -m src.remote_worker.worker_runner --job outputs/runtime_job.json

      - name: Run worker with sample job
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.drive_file_id == '' }}
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          GDRIVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ID: ${{ secrets.GDRIVE_OUTPUT_FOLDER_ID }}
        run: python -m src.remote_worker.worker_runner --job jobs/examples/add_panel_notes.json

      - name: Upload short-lived artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hscad-remote-worker-output
          path: outputs/jobs/**
          retention-days: 1
workflows.mobile-remote-control.yml:
name: Mobile Remote Control

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task:
        description: Free-quota task to run from GitHub mobile or web
        required: true
        default: doctor-linux
        type: choice
        options:
          - doctor-linux
          - python-tests-linux
          - mobile-cad-tests-linux
          - windows-doctor
          - windows-package
      ref_note:
        description: Optional note identifying the requested test
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: mobile-remote-${{ github.ref }}-${{ inputs.task }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  linux:
    if: ${{ contains(fromJSON('["doctor-linux","python-tests-linux","mobile-cad-tests-linux"]'), inputs.task) }}
    name: ${{ inputs.task }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout requested branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Record request
        shell: bash
        env:
          REQUEST_TASK: ${{ inputs.task }}
          REQUEST_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          REQUEST_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          REQUEST_NOTE: ${{ inputs.ref_note }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          {
            printf 'task=%s\n' "$REQUEST_TASK"
            printf 'ref=%s\n' "$REQUEST_REF"
            printf 'sha=%s\n' "$REQUEST_SHA"
            printf 'note=%s\n' "$REQUEST_NOTE"
            printf 'requested_at=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          } > test-results/mobile-request.txt

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        if: inputs.task != 'mobile-cad-tests-linux'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip

      - name: Install Python project
        if: inputs.task != 'mobile-cad-tests-linux'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run environment doctor
        if: inputs.task == 'doctor-linux'
        run: python -m src.main doctor | tee test-results/doctor.txt

      - name: Run Python tests
        if: inputs.task == 'python-tests-linux'
        run: python -m pytest -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1 --junitxml=test-results/junit.xml

      - name: Detect mobile CAD app
        if: inputs.task == 'mobile-cad-tests-linux'
        id: mobile_app
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ -f apps/mobile-cad-chatgpt/package-lock.json ]]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Mobile CAD app is not present on this branch. Use PR #127 branch or merge it first." > test-results/mobile-cad-skipped.txt
          fi

      - name: Set up Node.js 22
        if: inputs.task == 'mobile-cad-tests-linux' && steps.mobile_app.outputs.present == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/mobile-cad-chatgpt/package-lock.json

      - name: Test mobile CAD app
        if: inputs.task == 'mobile-cad-tests-linux' && steps.mobile_app.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          npm --prefix apps/mobile-cad-chatgpt ci
          npm --prefix apps/mobile-cad-chatgpt run typecheck
          npm --prefix apps/mobile-cad-chatgpt test
          npm --prefix apps/mobile-cad-chatgpt run build

      - name: Upload compact result bundle
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mobile-remote-${{ inputs.task }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 1

  windows:
    if: ${{ contains(fromJSON('["windows-doctor","windows-package"]'), inputs.task) }}
    name: ${{ inputs.task }}
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout requested branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip

      - name: Install Python project
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path test-results | Out-Null
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run Windows environment doctor
        if: inputs.task == 'windows-doctor'
        shell: pwsh
        run: python -m src.main doctor | Tee-Object -FilePath test-results/doctor-windows.txt

      - name: Build Windows package
        if: inputs.task == 'windows-package'
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/build_windows_release.ps1

      - name: Upload one-day Windows result bundle
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mobile-remote-${{ inputs.task }}-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            test-results/
            dist/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 1

workflows.upstream-audit.yml:
name: upstream-audit

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 2 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate-pins:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Validate lock structure
        run: python scripts/upstream/check_pins.py
      - name: Compare pins with current upstream heads
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python scripts/upstream/check_pins.py \
            --online \
            --json-output upstream-audit.json
      - name: Record audit provenance
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          path = Path("upstream-audit.json")
          payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
          payload["audit_provenance"] = {
              "repository": os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"],
              "workflow": os.environ["GITHUB_WORKFLOW"],
              "run_id": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
              "run_attempt": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"],
              "source_sha": os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"],
              "source_ref": os.environ["GITHUB_REF"],
          }
          path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: upstream-audit-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: upstream-audit.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
